dct_description_sm: To quantify the temporal evolution and spatial variation of first-year sea ice melt ponds at the regional scale, five aerial photography surveys were flown via fixed-wing Twin Otter aircraft from the Resolute Bay airport. Flights took place during local mornings or evenings in order to coincide with the typical descending and ascending RADARSAT-2 overpass times, so that the effect of melt ponds on C-band polarimetric backscatter (as per RADARSAT-2) can be assessed.
dct_title_s: Aerial Photography of first-year sea ice melt ponds for Arctic-ICE 2012
